data.content:
damage,risk factor	DNA
Ultraviolet Radiation
Ultraviolet radiation can damage DNA in skin cells.

cause,risk factor	Basal Cell Carcinoma
Ultraviolet Radiation
Ultraviolet radiation is a major risk factor for basal cell carcinoma.

damage,location	DNA
Skin Cells
DNA is located in skin cells and can be damaged by ultraviolet radiation.

prevention,treatment	Immunosuppressive Medicines
Organ Transplant Recipients
Organ transplant recipients take immunosuppressive medicines to prevent graft rejection.

cause,effect	Immunosuppression
Immunosuppressive Medicines
Immunosuppressive medicines cause immunosuppression, which weakens immune surveillance.

increase,risk factor	Basal Cell Carcinoma
Immunosuppression
Immunosuppression increases the risk of basal cell carcinoma.

removal,treatment	Basal Cell Carcinoma
Mohs Surgery
Mohs surgery is used to remove basal cell carcinoma, especially high-risk cases in cosmetically sensitive areas.
